Context: Pseudonymous Complaints.-

## Pseudonymous Complaints.-  
- (i) Where the action was initiated on anonymous/pseudonymous complaints prior to the issue of CVC's Circular, dated 29-6-1-999 and was pending as on 29-6-1999, it can be pursued further to its
- logical end.
- (ii) Where action was initiated between the period 11-10-2002 amd 25-11-2014 with prior concurrence of CVC b.ut .is pending, further
- action is permissible on such complaints.
